title: Measurement: nine stage skills generated from the canonical definitions, packaged, loaded and checked in every CI cell
summary: Measurement of TSK-0046's stage-skill generator, its check command and the packaged outputs through CI. GitHub Actions run 34757872027 at commit 41b7ac6, attempt 1 with no job retried, matrix ubuntu-latest x windows-latest by node 22 (v22.23.2) and node 24 (v24.20.0), all four cells green: 1008 tests and 0 failures in every cell, zero failing-test lines in the log. In every cell the step "Check the generated stage skills" ran npm run skills:check after "Install dependencies" (npm ci) and before "Run the test suite", and printed "[stage-skills] clean: all 9 generated skills match stages/.". The live Pi compatibility step on ubuntu-latest node 24 ran 5 tests and passed 5. WHAT RAN, BY NAME, IN EVERY CELL. All 11 pure-generator tests (test/stage-skills.test.mjs), all 11 command tests (test/stage-skills-cli.test.mjs), all 4 packaged-output tests (test/stage-skills-packaged.test.mjs), all 15 package-validation tests (test/pi-package.test.mjs) and all 4 real-load tests (test/pi-package-load.test.mjs) were matched by name against their source files and passed in each of the four cells - 180 name matches, none missing, failed or skipped. NINE IDENTITIES AT THEIR PATHS. The real stage definitions generate exactly kiln-stage-01-intake, kiln-stage-02-intent-decomposition, kiln-stage-03-discovery, kiln-stage-04-requirement-gaps, kiln-stage-05-solution-design, kiln-stage-06-risk-feasibility, kiln-stage-07-acceptance-criteria, kiln-stage-08-implementation-plan, kiln-stage-09-handoff, each at pi-package/skills/<name>/SKILL.md with that name in its frontmatter, as read by Pi's own frontmatter parser. The committed skills directory holds exactly kiln-planning and these nine, and each generated directory holds only its SKILL.md. CONTENT COPIED FROM THE CANONICAL DEFINITIONS. Each skill carries its definition's decision owner, its outputs - output prose first, then the typed artifacts, then the outputs not yet typed - and its exit criteria in definition order, verbatim. Output prose is rendered once, inside Outputs, and never labelled as purpose (F88). Nothing a definition does not declare is written as if it did: purpose, method, next-activity selection, delegations and required capabilities, the mutation and approval boundaries and the completion summary are named only in a closing section stating that the canonical definition does not declare them yet. A definition missing an in-scope field, holding a multi-line value, carrying an id that would not be a loadable Pi skill name, or duplicating another is refused by stage and field, with no default. YAML and Markdown metacharacters survive into the frontmatter exactly. DETERMINISTIC BYTES, NO MACHINE DATA. The same definitions produce byte-identical output whatever their input order or the working directory; the generator's source reads no filesystem, environment, clock or randomness. Every committed generated file is byte-equal to the pure generator's output, uses LF only, ends in exactly one newline, and carries the generated header naming its source definition. .gitattributes forces LF for pi-package/skills/**/SKILL.md, and the check passed on Windows and Ubuntu checkouts. DRIFT IS NAMED, AND THE CHECK WRITES NOTHING. In temporary copies of the tool, check mode exits 1 naming each affected skill in skill-name order: stale after a stage definition is edited, after a hand edit, and after CRLF line endings; missing when a skill directory or only its SKILL.md is gone; orphaned when a generated skill's definition is gone. Malformed or missing definitions and a missing skills directory exit 2 in both modes. A generated name that is a link or junction, not a directory, or holds extra files is refused rather than followed, and an orphan holding content the generator did not write is reported while write mode refuses and writes nothing. Every check - clean, drifted or refused - leaves the tree's entries, bytes and modification times unchanged, and the program run as a separate process, from a copied tool root, reports what the plan reports and changes nothing. Write mode creates exactly the nine, removes only orphans it wrote, and re-checks clean afterwards. KILN-PLANNING STAYS OUTSIDE GENERATOR OWNERSHIP. The generator owns kiln-stage-* names and no other. kiln-planning and every other skill it does not own are never read, reported, changed or removed by write or check, asserted against a handwritten sentinel in the command tests; kiln-planning is absent from commit 41b7ac6's diff. EXACT TEN-SKILL DECLARATION AND REAL PI LOADING. pi-package/signature.json declares exactly kiln-planning and the nine, compared as sets with the skills the package validation finds, and the manifest still declares the single ./skills directory. Through the pinned runtime's own resource loader, a trusted project loads all ten, each from its own path inside the package with project scope, beside a user-scoped control skill; with no trust decision and with an explicit denial, none of the package's skills, extension or prompt is discovered while the control still is. With the entry point broken, all ten skills are still discovered. UNCONDITIONAL CI EXECUTION. The workflow step has no condition, sits between npm ci and npm test, and the matrix remains both platforms by both Node versions - asserted by a test and observed in all four cells of this run. The package scripts skills:generate and skills:check run the command. WATCH ITEM F89, UNRELATED SHUTDOWN EVIDENCE. On the generator commit 496bd3d, run 34754268579 attempt 1 failed in windows-latest node 24 only (job 103715878001, v24.20.0: 993 tests, 991 pass, 1 fail, 1 skipped): test/shutdown-evidence.test.mjs PLATFORM EVIDENCE (win32, natural) refused as shutdown-not-observed, with only the agent and launcher descendant look-ups unresolved. All 11 generator tests passed in all four cells of that attempt. The failed job alone was re-run as attempt 2 (job 103717183008, v24.20.0: 993 tests, 992 pass, 0 fail, 1 skipped) and every evidence record was complete. In run 34757872027 all eight shutdown evidence records were complete with nothing unobserved, and no shutdown-not-observed refusal appeared. The fail-closed assertion was not weakened. FINDING F90, LOCAL EXFAT DISCOVERY ORDER, NO PRODUCTION CHANGE. Before commit 41b7ac6, the package-validation test compared the skill names package validation returns, in readdirSync order, with a list written in alphabetical order. The repository's local volume is exFAT, which enumerates in creation order; a local restoration control had recreated kiln-stage-04-requirement-gaps, so it was enumerated last and the test failed locally (targeted 45 run, 44 pass, 1 fail; full suite 1008 run, 1005 pass, 1 fail, 2 skipped). Discovery order is not part of the contract, and production package validation already compares declared and found names as sorted sets. The two test assertions now compare sorted copies without mutating either source; locally, with the order still scrambled, the targeted tests passed 45 of 45 and the suite 1006 of 1008 with 2 skipped. It never reached CI. MUTATION AND RESTORATION CONTROLS, LOCAL ONLY. Generator slice: fourteen mutations, each alone with the file restored byte-identical, all killed; a first mutation that changed nothing made no claim and was replaced by one that carried the undeclared field through, which was killed. Command slice: fifteen mutations, all killed in a re-run guarded by a fingerprint of the repository's pi-package/skills. Artifact slice: five restoration controls - a generated file hand-edited, a generated skill deleted, an orphaned generated skill added, a stage definition changed, and the CI check removed - each failed its guard (skills:check exit 1 naming the stale, missing, orphaned or stale skill respectively, or, for the removed CI step, the CI test) and was restored byte-identical with git status back to baseline.

omissions.reason: CI did not deliberately scramble filesystem enumeration order, and the log does not record the order ext4 or NTFS enumerated the skills. Order independence of the package test was observed only locally, on exFAT with one skill enumerated out of alphabetical order (F90), and no test permutes discovery order on purpose.

The canonical stage definitions' provenance remains draft. This evidence proves the skills are faithful, deterministic generations of those definitions; it does not establish that the decision owners, outputs or exit criteria they declare are the right methodology.

Purpose, method, next-activity selection, delegations and required capabilities, the mutation and approval boundaries and the completion summary are not generated, because no canonical field carries them. They belong to TSK-0071 and ACC-0112.

The fourteen generator mutations, fifteen command mutations and five artifact restoration controls were run locally on Windows before the commits. CI establishes that the tests and the check pass on both platforms; that they fail against these defects is established only by those local runs.

During the command slice, the first test and mutation harness ran the repository's own bin/generate-stage-skills.mjs. Under the mutations where --check wrote before checking and where an unknown argument fell through to write mode, the mutated program generated the nine kiln-stage-* skills into the working tree's pi-package/skills. A temporary working directory did not isolate it, because the program resolves its tool root from its own location. The nine directories were verified as exactly one generated SKILL.md each and removed without recursion, kiln-planning was confirmed unchanged, the process test was rewritten to run a copy of the program and lib/ in a temporary tool root, and the mutation harness now fingerprints the repository's pi-package/skills and stops on any change. The guarded re-run killed all fifteen mutations with the repository unchanged; the kills recorded for those two mutations remain valid, only their side effect was wrong.

F89 is an intermittent watch item unrelated to stage skills: the Windows descendant look-ups in the shutdown evidence were unresolved once, in run 34754268579 attempt 1, and passed on re-run and in every cell since. The supervisor records only look-up outcome counts and the process-table timeout, not how long each query took, so neither attempt shows the cause.
The CI matrix is ubuntu-latest and windows-latest. macOS is not built, not tested and not claimed.
